title: CAPTF contract v1alpha1: shared definitions
description: Types shared by the role input and output schemas (https://captf.io/docs/module-author/contract/v1alpha1/common.html). Input objects are closed (additionalProperties: false) because the controller renders exactly these attributes; output objects are open because extra attributes are ignored (README.md "Type conventions"). Limits come from the CAPI v1.14.2 API markers cited per property.

captf_contract.description: Contract version the inputs were generated for.

captf_cluster.description: The owning CAPI Cluster: name and namespace only (no uid, labels, annotations or generation; common.md "What is hashed").

captf_object.description: The Terraform* object being reconciled: kind, name and namespace only.

captf_tags.description: The fixed tag keys the controller always sets (common.md). No other keys.

captf.io/template.description: The object's cluster.x-k8s.io/cloned-from-name annotation, or "" when absent.

kubernetes_version.description: Kubernetes version, passed verbatim (may carry a distro suffix such as +rke2r1); 1-256 chars (Machine.spec.version marker, capi/api/core/v1beta2/machine_types.go).

endpoint.description: APIEndpoint: host 1-512 chars, port 1-65535; both set (APIEndpoint.IsValid, capi/api/core/v1beta2/cluster_types.go). A half-set endpoint is invalid.

endpoint_input.description: endpoint as rendered by the controller: exactly host and port.

cidr_blocks.description: NetworkRanges.cidrBlocks: at most 100 entries, each 1-43 chars (capi/api/core/v1beta2/cluster_types.go).

cluster_network.description: Cluster.spec.clusterNetwork as rendered: every attribute is present; unset values are null or [] (cluster.md). api_server_port is not the kube-apiserver bind port with KCP.

failure_domain_name.description: Failure-domain name: 1-256 chars, no pattern (FailureDomain.Name, capi/api/core/v1beta2/cluster_types.go).

failure_domain.description: One entry of the cluster role's failure_domains output. Name uniqueness (listMapKey=name) is enforced by the controller, not by this schema.

control_plane.description: optional(bool, true): the default is applied by the controller.

attributes.description: optional(map(string), {}): the default is applied by the controller.

machine_address.description: MachineAddress: type from the MachineAddressType enum, address 1-256 chars (capi/api/core/v1beta2/common_types.go).

pool_instance.description: One entry of the machinepool role's instances output; provider-defined shape, all but provider_id optional (machinepool.md).

health.description: The health output every role declares (common.md). state is a closed enum.

message.description: Optional; surfaced in the condition message.
